title: php-cs-fixer-action inputs
description: Typed contract for action.yml inputs. GitHub Actions always pass strings.

config-path.description: Empty, or a relative path inside the workspace (no .. or absolute paths).

rules-version.description: Git ref of ale94lko/php-cs-fixer-rules (no .., empty segments, or path escape).

paths.description: Empty (use config finder) or space-separated relative workspace paths.

allow-risky.description: Passed to php-cs-fixer as --allow-risky. Default yes preserves prior Action behavior.

php-bin.description: Empty (use php) or a bare command / absolute path without .. segments.

working-directory.description: Empty, or a relative workspace subdirectory for the fixer cwd.

using-cache.description: Empty omits --using-cache; yes/no passes the flag.

cache-file.description: Empty omits --cache-file; otherwise a relative workspace path.

only-changed.description: When true, derive PHP paths from git diff vs base-ref.

base-ref.description: Git ref for only-changed diffs (empty uses origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF).
